Gunmark

Your armory, documented. Every gun, every angle, every mod, every receipt and tax stamp — on your device, nowhere else.

Coming soon · Beta signups open
Features

Every gun, fully documented

Gunmark is a private catalog for your collection — photos, build history, maintenance, and paperwork, all in one place and all on your phone.

📸

Guided Photo Checklists

A step-by-step checklist walks you through every angle for each firearm, so your records are complete instead of one blurry photo from move-in day.

🔧

Per-Gun Build History

Log every component and modification against the firearm it belongs to — optics, triggers, barrels — and see the build take shape over time.

🧾

Receipts & Tax Stamps

Attach receipts, NFA forms, and tax stamps directly to the item they belong to. When you need a document, it's exactly where you'd expect.

🛠

Maintenance Log

Track cleanings, round counts, and service history per firearm — know at a glance what's due and what was done last.

📄

Export Anytime

Generate a PDF or CSV report of your collection whenever you need one — for insurance, an estate plan, or your own records.

⌨️

Fast, Smart Entry

Type-ahead suggestions for manufacturers, calibers, and models make adding a new firearm quick instead of a chore.

🔐

Face ID Lock

Lock the app behind Face ID or Touch ID. Your collection details stay private even if someone else picks up your phone.

🔒

No Accounts, No Servers

Gunmark makes zero network calls. There's no account to create and no server to trust — your data simply never leaves the device.

Beta testers wanted

We're looking for people with real collections and blunt opinions.

🎯 Competitive shooters 🧪 Handloaders 🗄 Collectors 📋 Suppressor & NFA owners
Request a beta invite →

You'll need an iPhone on iOS 18 or later and Apple's TestFlight app. Signups are handled on gunmark.app.
